scope: Fourteen optional typed score display keys: brackets and system separator, single/multi name visibility and system mode, first/other name form and orientation, and global dynamics/tuning/chord display. Other owned stylesheet groups remain independent.
authority: Each optional public ScoreStyle leaf owns only its corresponding key. Nil removes the key and preserves absence in Go; the consumer applies defaults. False name visibility dominates mode independently of key order; true visibility does not override mode. The last duplicate key wins.
export_policy: Complete source exports are permissive and record every exact report. Four authored scenarios clear unrelated legacy provenance and use strict export with only gp8.normalize.track-name-page-policy allowed. Undefined enums remain hard errors.
consumer_limit: Authored track-name mode 1 remains exact in public Go and typed GP8 wire. The pinned consumer has no separate first-system-of-each-page policy: it becomes FirstSystem when visible and Hidden when false visibility dominates. Each authored mode 1 produces a scoped normalization report and requires an explicit strict allowance. Export capability remains partial.
